items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bobby McFerrin also is very good at that.

ctx.x: Is there a way of practicing that?

Oh sure. You try to approximate the sound the sound of a guitar. [Hendricks sings.] Then when you get to a saxophone, it’s [Hendricks sings] a little more legato, and a trumpet is more percussive [Hendricks sings]. Sure, you try to approximate the actual sound of the instrument. The actual sound of the instrument determines your sound, because whatever you do to approximate the sound of the instrument becomes your sound, at the time, because you may want to change it.
